privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Disclaimer
privacy.privacyContent: BBPlayer is a locally-running Bilibili audio player. We only store the data required to run locally (playlists, play history, settings, login cookies). We do not upload your personal information to any third-party server. Login cookies are encrypted with the system secure storage and kept on this device, and are only used to fetch data you authorize from the official Bilibili APIs.
privacy.disclaimerContent: This application is for personal study and research only. The third-party playlist import feature accesses public endpoints of external platforms and automatically matches existing Bilibili videos; all copyright belongs to the original authors. Do not use imported content for any commercial purpose. Any copyright or compliance risks arising from the use of this application are borne by the user.
